title: Spicy Tofu Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and savory Japanese-inspired noodle dish featuring pan-seared tofu and a variety of spices.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

ingredients.name: unique noodles
ingredients.notes: rice noodles or soba noodles work well

ingredients.name: bitter
ingredients.notes: bitter melon or dark leafy greens such as kale

instructions: 1. Cook noodles according to package instructions.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, soy sauce, ginger, sesame oil, sugar, and red pepper flakes.
3. In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
4. Add tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
5. Remove tofu from skillet and set aside.
6. In the same skillet, add remaining 1 tablespoon of oil.
7. Add bitter and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
8. Add cooked noodles to skillet and toss with bitter and sauce.
9. Return tofu to skillet and toss to combine.
10. Serve hot, garnished with sesame seeds and green onions if desired.
